ov: Seven species of long-limbed New World monkeys that live high in the rainforest canopy. They hang by a prehensile tail with their limbs dangling, like a spider on a web, and have reduced or missing thumbs. All seven species are threatened.

why.et: Widely hunted for food because of its size, and gone from many easy-to-reach areas.

wt: About 11 kg (males of the largest species)
rg: Tropical forests from southern Mexico to Brazil.
df: Mostly fruit, with some leaves, flowers and insects.
fx: Bands of up to 35 split into smaller parties to forage during the day.
When threatened, they may break off branches weighing up to 4 kg and drop them on the intruder.
notes: Group entry. The animals.js fact is confirmed: the tail "serves as a fifth hand". "Herbivore" fits a mostly-fruit diet, though they eat some insects.
